verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs include a dedicated "Migration from Vue 2" guide, a first-party resource for moving between two incompatible major versions (Vue 2 to Vue 3). The evidence confirms only that the guide exists by title, not what it covers. missing for 10: evidence of the guide's depth (breaking-change coverage, migration build/tooling, step-by-step instructions), independent or hands-on corroboration that the guide works in practice.
